package design

import . "goa.design/goa/v3/dsl"
import . "goa.design/goa-ai/dsl"

var _ = API("openfields", func() {})
var Question = Type("Question", func() {
	Meta("openapi:additionalProperties", "true")
	Field(1, "message", String, func() { Meta("struct:tag:json", "message,case:strict") })
	Field(2, "extensions", MapOf(String, Bytes), func() {
		Elem(func() { Meta("struct:field:type", "json.RawMessage", "encoding/json") })
		Meta("struct:tag:json", ",embed")
	})
	Required("message")
})
var _ = Service("sample", func() {
	Method("echo", func() {
		Payload(Question)
		Result(Question)
		HTTP(func() { POST("/echo"); Response(StatusOK) })
		GRPC(func() { Response(CodeOK) })
	})
})

var _ = Service("tools", func() {
	MCP("tools", "1")
	JSONRPC(func() { POST("/mcp") })
	Method("lookup", func() {
		Payload(func() { Attribute("name", String); Required("name") })
		Result(String)
		Tool("lookup", "Look up a synthetic value")
	})
})
